items.title: HKSAR aligns laws with 'one country, two systems' principle
items.description: The Hong Kong Special Administrative Region gazetted on Thursday the Statute Law (Miscellaneous Provisions) Ordinance 2026 and three pieces of subsidiary legislation amending court rules, formally concluding a long-running legislative exercise to align the city's original laws with its constitutional status under the Constitution of the People's Republic of China and the Basic Law.
